title: feat(cli): add `--format github` workflow annotations
problem: PR annotations are produced by an ad-hoc `jq` step in the PR workflow instead of by the scanner, so local users cannot reproduce them and formats drift.
why: A first-class annotation format makes CI simpler and consistent and helps non-GitHub CI too.
scope: Add `github` to `--format`, emitting `::error`/`::warning`/`::notice` lines with file, line, and title.
Escape workflow command special characters correctly.
guidance: Reuse severity-to-level mapping; keep one line per finding.
acceptance: PR workflow uses it instead of jq
security: Escape all user-controlled text to prevent workflow-command injection from source paths or titles.

title: feat(cli): add shell completion generation
problem: Users must type rule ids and flags manually; there is no completion support.
scope: Add a hidden `completions <SHELL>` command generating scripts for bash, zsh, fish, and PowerShell.
guidance: Use `clap_complete`; keep the generator out of the default help output.
acceptance: Completions generate for all supported shells
tests: CLI test that output is non-empty and contains the binary name
deps: Adds the `clap_complete` dependency (justify in the PR).

title: feat(cli): add `doctor` diagnostics command
problem: When a scan finds nothing, users cannot tell whether the project was classified correctly, configuration was applied, or files were excluded.
why: A `doctor` command shortens the debugging loop and improves trust.
scope: Report discovered manifests, classification and evidence, source file count, excludes, effective config, and enabled rules.
Never print secrets or environment variables.
guidance: Reuse `project::load` and print a structured summary; support `--format json`.
tests: CLI tests on the generic and confirmed fixtures
security: Do not echo environment variables or absolute home paths.

title: feat(cli): add `--exclude-tests` convenience flag
problem: Excluding test code requires manual globs even though `#[cfg(test)]` handling is a known need.
why: One flag removes the most common source of noise.
scope: Add `--exclude-tests` that skips items gated behind `#[cfg(test)]` and test directories.
guidance: Reuse the cfg inspection from the parser backlog item.

title: feat(cli): support `--max-findings` to bound report size
problem: Large scans can produce thousands of findings, flooding terminals and CI logs.
why: Bounding output keeps reports readable and protects CI log limits.
scope: Add `--max-findings N` that truncates output with an explicit "N more" notice; the exit gate is unaffected.
guidance: Apply after sorting so truncation is deterministic.
acceptance: Exit code still reflects all findings
security: Never hide the fact that findings were truncated.

title: feat(cli): auto-detect color and add `--color` control
problem: Terminal output is monochrome, reducing readability of severity levels.
why: Color improves scanning speed for humans without affecting machine formats.
scope: Add `--color auto|always|never`; only colorize terminal output.
acceptance: Colorized output only for TTY terminal format
security: Never emit ANSI escapes into JSON/SARIF.
deps: May add a small color crate or emit raw ANSI.

title: feat(cli): add `--no-config` to ignore discovered configuration
problem: There is no way to run with pure defaults when debugging or when scanning an untrusted repo containing a config file.
why: Ignoring repository-provided configuration is useful for trust and reproducibility.
guidance: Ensure no config discovery occurs when set.
tests: CLI test with a repo config present
